run_body_hand_pose_sequence: run the script to process a video sequence and detect body and hand 2D keypoints using CPM networks
run_pose_visualization: run the script with the --visualize flag to display 2D and 3D pose plots for each frame
run_pose_save_images: run the script with the --save-image flag to export body and hand 2D crops and PAF visualizations as PNG files
run_upperbody_only: run the script with the --freeze flag to detect only upper body keypoints and ignore lower body
run_pose_with_frame_range: run the script with --start-from and --end-index to process a specific range of frames in the sequence
